entities.summary: Elena Loewenthal is an Italian historian and translator, specialising in Jewish history, having translated Louis Ginzberg's The Legends of the Jews in its six volumes into Italian under the Adelphi Edizioni publishing house. She was awarded the Grinzane Cavour Prize in 2003.
